narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed and trained along a stationary front draped across central Virginia on the night of August 29. These storms produced heavy rain and flash flooding given slow storm motions and cell mergers. Damaging wind gusts also occurred with the strongest storms.
ev: A County Official reported high water along Zion Road at US-15.
VDOT reported that Ellisville Drive at Blue Ridge Road was flooded. This road remained flooded until 7 AM the next morning.
VDOT reported that the intersection of Goldmine Road and Bibb Store Road was flooded. The road remained flooded until 7 AM the next day.
VDOT reported flooding at the intersection of Farrington Road and Greenwood Church Road. The road remained closed for a substantial amount of time.
VDOT reported that Genito Road was closed at Clover Hill High School due to standing water on the roadway.
